text:
Anna P: Quick sync — AlpineCloud co-hosted EU virtual workshop on 2025-05-14. Need to finalize speakers, live demo plan, and how we split swag shipments across EU hubs vs. ROW. Can we lock by EOD Friday? @lena @tom :spiral_calendar:

Tom H: I can own demo ops. Question — are we doing 2 parallel demo streams or a single main demo with breakout Q&A?

Lena G: Prefer single main demo (keeps latency and support simpler) + 20-min breakout for deep-dive. AlpineCloud to provide 1 speaker + 1 engineer for live failover.

Marco (AlpineCloud): Confirmed — we'll send Marco (speaker) and Nina (eng) remotely. We'll also ship a mini GPU testbox for the staged recording if needed. ETA for box: arrives to CZ hub by 05/09.

Tom H: Good. For failover plan: primary = live demo on Redwood Hosted (eu-west), fallback 1 = recorded segment in S3 + local playback, fallback 2 = demo on AlpineCloud's infra (we'll switch route). Need runbook and switch TTL < 30s.

Sophia M: Marketing wants the speaker bios and one-slide summary by 05/05. Also need the final talk title — current draft: "Reducing LLM inference cost at scale with hybrid routing" — ok?

Anna P: Title OK. Marketing also wants a QR quick-claim for swag pickups and a short form for shipping preferences. Suggest QR -> short URL -> Google Form + coupon code.

Tom H: Logistics note — ask partner for IP/driver installers for the GPU box; we can't install custom drivers during the live session. Also request a small recorded demo (3–5m) as immediate fallback.

Lena G: Ops checklist draft (packing & customs):
```
- 1x mini GPU box (serial: TBD) - weight 8kg
- 2x laptops with HDMI passthrough
- 5x demo backup videos (usb + cloud)
- 50 promo kits (stickers, postcard, redemption card)
- Customs invoice + product HS code: 847150
```

Anna P: Re swag split: we ship 60% of physical kits to EU hubs (DE/CZ/IE) and 40% held with AlpineCloud for on-site fulfillment in other regions. Need volumetric weights to finalize courier quotes. @logistics-bot can you create a shipment ticket?

logistics-bot: Shipment ticket created: SHIP-20250502-431. Requesting dimensions & final counts by 2025-05-06. Tracking emails will be auto-notified to #partnerships. :package:

Marco (AlpineCloud): We'll provide weight/dimensions for the mini box and promo kits by Tue 05/06. We can also localize postcard text in EN/DE/FR.

Sophia M: Recording ask: can we get a raw ISO of the session? Product will need it for post-event clips. Also please grant marketing S3 read to the fallback bucket (I'll DM perms).

Tom H: Run-of-show (high level):
- 10:00 Start / host intro (5m)
- 10:05 Partner keynote (12m)
- 10:17 Redwood demo (20m) + live Q&A (10m)
- 10:47 Breakouts (20m)
- 11:07 Closing and CTA (5m)

Lena G: Technical staging checklist (short):
- Prewarm Redwood model endpoints + warm KV cache
- Test streaming at 100 concurrent viewers in staging
- Confirm region routing policy for eu-west fallback
- Verify function calls and structured output for demo prompts

Anna P: Action items summary:
- Marco: speaker bios + mini-box dims by 05/06
- Marco: 3–5m recorded demo by 05/06
- Tom: draft runbook with TTL-based switch script by 05/07
- Lena: packing list & customs invoice template by 05/06
- Sophia: confirm marketing assets + S3 access by 05/08

Tom H: I'll post the initial runbook in #eng-runtime and tag ops for rehearsal. Can we schedule a full dress rehearsal (with partner) on 05/12 09:00 UTC?

Marco (AlpineCloud): 05/12 09:00 UTC works for us. We'll join from Prague lab.

Anna P: Great — locking rehearsal and deadlines. Thanks team :thumbsup: If anyone can't meet the dates, flag here ASAP.

Sophia M: I'll prepare the QR quick-claim flow and share a preview link tomorrow.

Tom H: Final note — include a short fallback slide with "How to reproduce the demo locally" (commands + container tag) so support can hand off to customer engineers quickly.

Anna P: Perfect. Closing thread for now; will reopen with runbook link.
